description: Figure 8b illustrates the performance on Llama2. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10<sup>1</sup> to 10<sup>3</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 10<sup>1</sup> and 10<sup>2</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and has a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. There are six lines displayed: a green solid line with triangle markers starting at approximately 63% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and ending at approximately 76% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>; a red dashed line with circle markers starting at approximately 66% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and ending at approximately 78% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>; a blue dashed line with square markers starting at approximately 65% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and ending at approximately 76% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>; a purple dotted line with diamond markers starting at approximately 64% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and ending at approximately 75% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>; a brown dashed line with x markers starting at approximately 65% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and ending at approximately 77% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>; and a magenta solid line with plus markers starting at approximately 66% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>1</sup> and ending at approximately 78% at a co-occurrence number of 10<sup>3</sup>.
